title: Karoline Leavitt's replacement as press secretary faces 'critical' test as midterms loom, Trump advisor says
summary: James Blair, senior political advisor to Trump, calls Karoline Leavitt "maybe the best press secretary" ever and says her successor will be under a "microscope" heading into midterms.

title: Trump backs Republican challenger to oust Letitia James amid ongoing mortgage fraud feud
summary: President Donald Trump endorsed Saritha Komatireddy to challenge Letitia James, calling the New York attorney general the "WORST" in the country.

title: Gun rights gets 'greatest restoration' in 100 years with latest Trump DOJ move, lawmaker hails
summary: Rep. Andrew Clyde calls the ruling removing the $200 tax on silencers and short-barreled rifles the greatest Second Amendment restoration in a century.

title: Socialist in Trump country gives Karl Marx vision thumbs-up before ducking key tax question
summary: Oliver Larkin defended taxing billionaires "out of existence" but repeatedly refused to give Sean Hannity a specific tax rate during their heated exchange.

title: Trump scores major immigration victory as judge clears way to end TPS protections for thousands of Somalis
summary: Trump scored a major legal victory as a federal judge in Boston lifted a stay blocking the termination of Somalia's TPS designation.

title: Trump leaves stage mid-speech to embrace parents of 12-year-old killed by stray bullet in the Bronx
summary: President Donald Trump left the stage mid-speech at the Nassau County Police Academy to embrace the parents of Jacob Freytes, a 12-year-old killed by a stray bullet.

title: Trump’s fight over rarely used 18th-century deportation law lives on in latest court clash
summary: The 5th Circuit dismissed a challenge to Trump's use of the Alien Enemies Act against alleged Tren de Aragua members after all plaintiffs were deported.

title: 1 in 6 adults plagued by loneliness as researchers reveal lasting impact of COVID pandemic
summary: An Imperial College London study of over 135,000 adults found nearly one in six people reported feeling lonely often, surprising researchers. COVID made things worse, the study noted.

title: CBS News correspondent accused of sexual harassment in former ABC producer's lawsuit
summary: Samira Said's lawsuit alleges Matt Gutman made sexualized comments and ABC denied her medical accommodations after covering the Uvalde school shooting.

title: Famed ex-Yankees pitcher Tommy John dead at 83 after sending farewell message to fans
summary: Tommy John released a heartfelt farewell message on Yankees Old-Timers' Day just one week before his death, thanking Dr. Jobe and fans.
